review.notes: All 27 physical pages' extracted text was block-compared against the OCR markdown after normalization, plus a whole-document numeric-token multiset check (page-number footers aside, no PDF number is missing from the OCR). Code fences are balanced (none present); all 15 chart figures are embedded as images. Physical pages 13 and 25 were rendered at 120 dpi and visually checked: both print '1. ...' items as indented numbered list items with visible siblings ('2. Goal-oriented, end-to-end attack automation', '2. Previous experience indicates 20h time horizons...'), so the OCR's promotion of these two items to level-2 headings is repaired. The printed table of contents (physical p.3, continuation of the p.2 Contents block) lists '5.2 Research category update: sandbagging ... 26'; OCR dropped the leading '5.2' from that TOC line. Kept without patches: four prose 'not\_unsafe' escapes render as the printed identifier not_unsafe (the fifth occurrence, a table cell, is already correct in OCR); 'Taint Shared Content' footnote markers and PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL tables match the text layer; TOC dot leaders were flattened, which does not change visible content.
